cond_0001.intro: Primary responsibilities in manufacturing are to drive department and enterprise key initiatives through continuous process improvement, improving customer satisfaction, reducing waste, increasing efficiency, and eliminating variation in manufacturing processes. Candidates for this position should have energy and passion to improve both our production and functional processes while leading with integrity. This role will directly support our milling department, where several large-scale changes are being made to update our processes and standards to the latest modern technology. Candidates for this role should have a strong technical aptitude, willingness to learn in a hands-on environment and have a strong bias for action.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Partner with operations, RD&I, quality, maintenance, and supply chain functions to drive improvements within the value-stream through new process and technology development
Develop and execute improvements in alignment with strategic vision of modernizing equipment, people, and processes
Support of milling operations focused on improving Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost
Work closely with production supervisors, team leads, and production employees to perform problem solving and root cause analysis
Lead continuous improvement projects aligned to lean manufacturing principles
Lead cost reductions and yield improvements with delivery partners
Utilize sound project management tools for complex projects and key initiatives
Improve equipment capability and reliability
Identify opportunities for error proofing and implement solutions
Respond to day to day production needs such as equipment troubleshooting and quality concerns
Manage the design, procurement, and startup of capital equipment projects
Partner with ongoing product development team to implement product design changes and line extensions
Be highly visible within the value stream to create a safe environment for collaboration
Promote a hands on, high involvement approach to problem solving
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Year degree in Engineering or Technology
Strong project management skills
Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles
Strong knowledge of quality systems, SPC and process capability
Positive attitude with a desire to build relationships and serve both our internal and external customers
Strong, proactive communicator, effective both 1:1 and in groups
Preferred Requirements
Mechanical Engineering Degree
Open to varying levels of experience
Equipment procurement experience
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value having a positive impact on the people our work affects. We aim to act with responsibility, fairness, and respect in the way we make decisions and deliver our work.

Primary responsibilities in manufacturing are to drive department and enterprise key initiatives through continuous process improvement, improving customer satisfaction, reducing waste, increasing efficiency, and eliminating variation in manufacturing processes. Candidates for this position should have energy and passion to improve both our production and functional processes while leading with integrity. This role will directly support our milling department, where several large-scale changes are being made to update our processes and standards to the latest modern technology. Candidates for this role should have a strong technical aptitude, willingness to learn in a hands-on environment and have a strong bias for action.
Partner with operations, RD&I, quality, maintenance, and supply chain functions to drive improvements within the value-stream through new process and technology development
Develop and execute improvements in alignment with strategic vision of modernizing equipment, people, and processes
Support of milling operations focused on improving Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost
Work closely with production supervisors, team leads, and production employees to perform problem solving and root cause analysis
Lead continuous improvement projects aligned to lean manufacturing principles
Lead cost reductions and yield improvements with delivery partners
Utilize sound project management tools for complex projects and key initiatives
Improve equipment capability and reliability
Identify opportunities for error proofing and implement solutions
Respond to day to day production needs such as equipment troubleshooting and quality concerns
Manage the design, procurement, and startup of capital equipment projects
Partner with ongoing product development team to implement product design changes and line extensions
Be highly visible within the value stream to create a safe environment for collaboration
Promote a hands on, high involvement approach to problem solving
cond_0075.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience (Mechanical Engineering background is a plus)
Some experience with project management, with a willingness to build on those skills over time
Familiarity with Lean manufacturing principles
Preferred Requirements
Experience with equipment procurement
Background in quality systems, SPC, and process capability
Ability to communicate effectively both one-on-one and in groups, with openness to feedback
A positive, collaborative approach and willingness to build relationships across internal and external teams
cond_0075.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0075.values: We value having a positive impact on the people our work affects. We aim to act with responsibility, fairness, and respect in the way we make decisions and deliver our work.
cond_0075.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.

Primary responsibilities in manufacturing are to drive department and enterprise key initiatives through continuous process improvement, improving customer satisfaction, reducing waste, increasing efficiency, and eliminating variation in manufacturing processes. Candidates for this position should have energy and passion to improve both our production and functional processes while leading with integrity. This role will directly support our milling department, where several large-scale changes are being made to update our processes and standards to the latest modern technology. Candidates for this role should have a strong technical aptitude, willingness to learn in a hands-on environment and have a strong bias for action.
Partner with operations, RD&I, quality, maintenance, and supply chain functions to drive improvements within the value-stream through new process and technology development
Develop and execute improvements in alignment with strategic vision of modernizing equipment, people, and processes
Support of milling operations focused on improving Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost
Work closely with production supervisors, team leads, and production employees to perform problem solving and root cause analysis
Lead continuous improvement projects aligned to lean manufacturing principles
Lead cost reductions and yield improvements with delivery partners
Utilize sound project management tools for complex projects and key initiatives
Improve equipment capability and reliability
Identify opportunities for error proofing and implement solutions
Respond to day to day production needs such as equipment troubleshooting and quality concerns
Manage the design, procurement, and startup of capital equipment projects
Partner with ongoing product development team to implement product design changes and line extensions
Be highly visible within the value stream to create a safe environment for collaboration
Promote a hands on, high involvement approach to problem solving
cond_0183.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience (Mechanical Engineering background is a plus)
Some experience with project management, with a willingness to build on those skills over time
Familiarity with Lean manufacturing principles
Preferred Requirements
Experience with equipment procurement
Background in quality systems, SPC, and process capability
Ability to communicate effectively both one-on-one and in groups, with openness to feedback
A positive, collaborative approach and willingness to build relationships across internal and external teams
cond_0183.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0183.values: We value having a positive impact on the people our work affects. We aim to act with responsibility, fairness, and respect in the way we make decisions and deliver our work.

This role will directly support our milling department, where several large-scale changes are being made to update our processes and standards to the latest modern technology. Candidates for this role should have a strong technical aptitude, willingness to learn in a hands-on environment and have a strong bias for action. People tend to become stronger in this kind of manufacturing engineering work over time as they build hands-on experience and learn from the challenges they encounter.
cond_0302.responsibilities:
Partner with operations, RD&I, quality, maintenance, and supply chain functions to drive improvements within the value-stream through new process and technology development
Develop and execute improvements in alignment with strategic vision of modernizing equipment, people, and processes
Support of milling operations focused on improving Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost
Work closely with production supervisors, team leads, and production employees to perform problem solving and root cause analysis
Lead continuous improvement projects aligned to lean manufacturing principles
Lead cost reductions and yield improvements with delivery partners
Utilize sound project management tools for complex projects and key initiatives
Improve equipment capability and reliability
Identify opportunities for error proofing and implement solutions
Respond to day to day production needs such as equipment troubleshooting and quality concerns
Manage the design, procurement, and startup of capital equipment projects
Partner with ongoing product development team to implement product design changes and line extensions
Be highly visible within the value stream to create a safe environment for collaboration
Promote a hands on, high involvement approach to problem solving
cond_0302.requirements:
4 Year degree in Engineering or Technology (Mechanical Engineering Degree preferred)
Open to varying levels of experience
Equipment procurement experience
Strong project management skills
Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles
Strong knowledge of quality systems, SPC and process capability
Positive attitude with a desire to build relationships and serve both our internal and external customers
Strong, proactive communicator, effective both 1:1 and in groups
cond_0302.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0302.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.
cond_0302.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.

cond_0330.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. Primary responsibilities in manufacturing are to drive department and enterprise key initiatives through continuous process improvement, improving customer satisfaction, reducing waste, increasing efficiency, and eliminating variation in manufacturing processes. Candidates for this position should have energy and desire to improve both our production and functional processes while leading with integrity. This role will directly support our milling department, where several large-scale changes are being made to update our processes and standards to the latest modern technology. Candidates for this role should have a strong technical aptitude, willingness to learn in a hands-on environment and have a strong bias for action.
cond_0330.responsibilities:
Partner with operations, RD&I, quality, maintenance, and supply chain functions daily to drive improvements within the value-stream through new process and technology development
Develop and execute improvements in alignment with strategic vision of modernizing equipment, people, and processes
Support milling operations focused on improving Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost
Work closely with production supervisors, team leads, and production employees to perform problem solving and root cause analysis — actively contributing to discussions and bringing people together to resolve issues
Lead continuous improvement projects aligned to lean manufacturing principles
Lead cost reductions and yield improvements with delivery partners
Utilize sound project management tools for complex projects and key initiatives
Improve equipment capability and reliability
Identify opportunities for error proofing and implement solutions
Respond to day to day production needs such as equipment troubleshooting and quality concerns, staying in regular contact with the team
Manage the design, procurement, and startup of capital equipment projects
Partner with ongoing product development team to implement product design changes and line extensions
Be highly visible within the value stream to create a safe environment for collaboration
Promote a hands on, high involvement approach to problem solving
cond_0330.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Year degree in Engineering or Technology
Strong project management skills
Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles
Strong knowledge of quality systems, SPC and process capability
Strong, proactive communicator, effective both 1:1 and in groups
Preferred Requirements
Mechanical Engineering degree
Equipment procurement experience
Positive attitude with a desire to build relationships and serve both internal and external customers
Open to varying levels of experience.
